scope: One explicitly authorized first production workspace plus Owner membership for an existing mapped principal; names, email and personal IDs redacted from Git.

backup.contents: Private production SQL; not committed. Export log with expiring signed URL remains private.

write.method: Temporary loopback-only operator Worker with remote D1 binding; native DB.batch of prepared/bound SQL
guards: Existing mapped user ID, user version, explicit email target, identity ID/provider/tenant
Unique fresh UUIDv7 workspace/member IDs and slug
Fresh mutation marker gates dependent inserts; no copy or update of other memberships/preferences

verification.canonicalBootstrap: Production application readBootstrap and membership executed against remote D1; workspace and both preference documents verified.
verification.browserSession: No user cookie/token read; user can press Check again on waiting screen.

cleanup.temporaryOperatorToken: Removed from private input after shutdown

rollback: Before any rollback, re-read current versions and references and make a new backup. A first-workspace rollback must only remove the exact newly created preference/membership/workspace records when unchanged and unused; do not restore the whole production DB or remove profile/auth/session data.
limits: One-time authorized administration; no permanent public workspace creation/grant API, generic provisioning framework or role-policy change.
No source or schema change; no build/redeploy required. Four targeted operational probes plus independent D1 read are the verification for this data change.
Private local receipt/input/backup contain the exact target for operator reconciliation; never stage these files.
